topic: Emergency deployment versus GLPI and Standard preapproval
owner_role: PMO, Engineering, Security and prescribed approval owners
required_evidence: Written reconciliation of emergency authorization and general predeployment GLPI; approved Standard-change catalogue and explicit satisfied/remaining gates.
do_not_reask: Do not infer emergency waiver or blanket preapproval.

topic: Signed SOW before Planning versus Planning inputs forming SOW basis
required_evidence: None for the sequence. Actual contract revisions still follow the established change/costing controls.
do_not_reask: Known cost-changing revisions already repeat costing chain; do not ask that again.
resolution: U01 confirms detailed planning and costing before signed SOW. Do not re-ask this order.

topic: Prices versus signing in billing narrative
required_evidence: Check source recording segment or obtain written confirmation of intended statement plus actual invoice-flow release controls.
do_not_reask: FIN P0023 says prices; VID U0079 says sign. No new signature gate assumed.

required_evidence: IANA timezone, clock anchors/pauses, holidays/working calendar; exact choice within1–2workingdays; meeting hour/report day; actual SLA notice clauses and billing dates.
do_not_reask: Known Tuesday/weekly/monthly and24h/48h rules are already filled.

owner_role: Prescribed approval owners and identity administrator
required_evidence: Named role assignments, delegation/absence, dual-role eligibility, reject/return/withdraw authority and non-cost invalidation rules.
do_not_reask: Do not request new approval gates or replace known role matrix.

topic: Native financial imports maps and exact oracles
required_evidence: Redacted TB/export plus native workbooks, account/BU maps, formula lineage, unit/sign/currency/period conventions, F07/F09/F39 expected examples and missing-match behavior.
do_not_reask: Known chain, exact F23 tie-out and narrated F25 formula are not unknown; observed cells remain narrow.

topic: Payroll sources and private allocation workings
owner_role: Finance allocation owner and HR data owner
required_evidence: Authorized redacted two-source samples, join/overlap semantics, effective staff/BU history, pool/ratio tables, denominator/monthly/rounding/residual examples.
do_not_reask: Headcount applies to described other-staff pool only; Finance HR-read-only boundary is already established.

topic: Actual invoice flow pricing and correction behavior
required_evidence: Flow export/environment/run evidence, exact input/output/effects, approved price effective dates/tax/tier/rounding, service billing dates, batch duplicate/correction examples and actual permissions.
do_not_reask: Generation/posting/sending are distinct actions, not invented mandatory approval gates.

required_evidence: Referenced Support SOP and Reconciliation brief; redacted settled/pending/failed/corrected examples, identifiers/cutoff, queue commands/states/access and completion evidence; onboarding stage catalogue.
do_not_reask: Do not infer business queue semantics from infrastructure queues or grant direct credit access.

required_evidence: Names/effective dates of added categories; approved restatement/correction treatment; forecast inclusion/opening-balance/partial-receipt rules and exact internal/group projection.
do_not_reask: Forecast is partial, not assumed100% coverage; known annual budget method need not be rediscovered.

required_evidence: Named recipients/grants and any remaining external adapter details; controlled document templates, storage/retention, migration and evidence requirements; Engineering hypercare criteria. PMO milestone ownership and absence of requested document tooling are now answered by U02/U03.
do_not_reask: Do not ask which existing document/evidence tool to integrate or whether Finance must approve PMO milestone completion. PSL tooling is requested; PMO establishes completion.

topic: Stage schedule and precise trigger evidence
owner_role: PMO and Finance with commercial contract owner
required_evidence: Approved contract schedule with stage amounts or percentages, currency/tax basis, due terms and rounding; exact completion-stage event; which UAT record establishes the billing trigger. Example signed agreement with invoice/receipt references.
do_not_reask: Three stages, signed-SOW opening trigger, UAT-stage invoice and PMO milestone ownership are already supplied. No50/30/20 default.

topic: Configure human payment exception authority and assessment basis
owner_role: PMO, Finance and existing release authority owners
required_evidence: Actual authorized human role/principals and delegation evidence when available; approved exception validity/revocation/reassessment rules; agreed payment denominator and qualifying funds basis. Do not enable exception approval before authority is configured.
do_not_reask: Exception capability and human-only approval are confirmed. The user cannot name the role yet; keep UNCONFIGURED without blocking unrelated definition work.

required_evidence: Verification source and authorized receipt recorder; allocation priority/approval, refunds/credits/write-offs/chargebacks, correction permissions and legal/accounting document requirements. Provide approved examples including unmatched and excess payment.
do_not_reask: Irregular partial payments and Finance responsibility are known. Technical conservation and audit rules do not decide accounting policy.
